==Initial dialogue==
* '''Arhein:''' Hello there!
* '''Player:''' Hello! Who are you?
* '''Arhein:''' The name's Arhein. I'm a local merchant. I have a variety of useful goods to sell here, and I also use my ship to deliver various items further afield.
* {{Tact|end}}

==Subsequent dialogue==
* '''Arhein:''' Hello again!
* {{topt|What do you have for sale?}}
** '''Player:''' What do you have for sale?
** '''Arhein:''' All sorts of things! Why don't you take a look?
** {{tact|opens=Arhein's General Goods}}
* {{topt|What's with the duck?}}
** {{tact|Continues in [[Transcript:Current Affairs]]}}
* {{topt|cond=If the player has lost the Mayor of Catherby:|I'm sorry, but I've lost the mayor.}}
** '''Player:''' I'm sorry, but I've lost the mayor.
** '''Arhein:''' Oh dear. Good job we have backups now. Here you go.
** {{tbox|pic=Mayor of Catherby detail.png|Arhein gives you a new mayor.}}
** '''Arhein:''' I believe that puts us at mayor [# of replaced mayors + 27] now. Long live the mayor.
** {{tact|end}}
* {{topt|Where abouts do you make deliveries to?}}
** '''Arhein:''' Oh, various places up and down the coast. Mostly Karamja and Port Sarim.
** {{topt|I don't suppose I could get a lift anywhere?}}
*** '''Player:''' I don't suppose I could get a lift anywhere?
*** '''Arhein:''' Sorry, but that's not the kind of service I offer. Why not try the charter ship?
*** '''Player:''' I might do that. Thanks.
*** {{tact|end}}
** {{topt|I see. Well, I'd best be off.}}
*** '''Player:''' I see. Well, I'd best be off.
*** '''Arhein:''' Until next time!
*** {{tact|end}}
* {{topt|I'd best be off.}}
** '''Player:''' I'd best be off.
** {{tact|end}}

===When attempting to board his ship===
* '''Arhein:''' Hey! Did I say you could board my ship?
* '''Player:''' Oh... sorry.
* {{tact|end}}
